# Present Tense

> Present Tense turns your live screen into shared, structured state: crisp text on every device, resilient on bad wifi. A live presentation surface by Sentence Labs, coming soon.

Present Tense sends your screen as text and structure rather than video, so every attendee's device renders a sharp, native view even on poor venue wifi.

## Links

- [Home](https://present-tense.io/): product overview and contact
- [Sentence Labs](https://sentence-labs.com): parent company, an applied research lab building infrastructure for real-time, structured interaction
- [Contact](mailto:hi@sentence-labs.com): questions, feedback, and early access
